description: An argument that begins with three hyphens is classified in the double-hyphen arm, and numGivenHyphens is stored as 2.
notes: The structure comment says numGivenHyphens is the number of hyphens in the original argument. The double-hyphen arm writes the constant 2. This case follows the assignment.

provenance.note: Compared with CLASP 0.16.0.67 (CLASP_VER = 0x00100043) at revision 0afd4611372a94b6441e593ef57fa8d4b1306c65. Any token whose second character is '-' takes the double-hyphen arm, which assigns numGivenHyphens = 2 rather than counting hyphens.
